# Zoom Into Homes

> Las Vegas and Henderson real estate practice that tours homes on video first, writes doorway and bathroom measurements, then visits two or three finalists. Agent: Dr. Gene Boyle (California DRE #02282581). Nevada partner: Dr. Jan Duffy, License S.0197614.LLC, Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties. Call (702) 222-1964.

This file is a first-party URL map for retrieval systems. It restates facts already visible on the site. It is not a Google ranking file.

Service area: Las Vegas, Henderson, North Las Vegas, Summerlin, Enterprise, Spring Valley, Paradise. Planning office: 320 Junco, Irvine, CA 92618. Housing copy describes building features, not people.
